name: Augusta, Order Returned

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, each player exiles a card from their graveyard. When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way, put that many +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature.

notes: APPROXIMATION: nothing counts the nonland cards a preceding effect exiled, so 'that many' is written as the number of players (one card per player is exiled, so that is the upper bound); the reflexive 'When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way' is folded into the same resolution rather than a second trigger (see needs).

problems: round trip 0.43 < 0.55: "Whenever ~ attacks, each player exiles a card from their graveyard. When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way, put that many +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature." rendered as "whenever ~ attacks, exile a card from your graveyard. put the number of opponents you have plus 1 +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature"
